item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) Class-D claims to be an 05
item.content:encoded:
Class-D claims to be 05-14, yet there are no records of him every being on the 05 council or there ever being a 14th member of the 05

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): mainly mystery, slight comedy,

Page Layout (Optional): Aiming to make it as short and simple as I can

Elevator Pitch: A Class-D claims to be an 05-14, no proof of him being an 05, but there is mystery as how he got this way.

Central Narrative: There is a Class-D who claims to be an 05 council member. Due to little evidence supporting him, and a history supporting him being a Class-D, they do not make him an 05. However, they do not terminate him at the end of the month and make him a SCP because he knows stuff only an 05 knows.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber: At the end of the SCP in an addendum, the site director says something like, "We do not know for certain that he is an 05 despite him having classified information. He could be an attempt at infiltration by a GoI, a Class-D who anomalously got his hands on classified information and is attempting to avoid end-of-the-month termination. Maybe he actually is 05-14 and was placed as a Class-D. We really do not know anything about him, and it is much safer to simply contain him than to blindly trust any assumptions. Rest assured, we are investigating this."

Additional Notes: If I manage to fit it in somehow, I can imply that some sort of group inside the Foundation intend to put him back up into the 05 council. As in, maybe some guard slips him a note saying that he believes him, and intends to break him out/investigate it himself. Also, apologies for any mistakes I make, this is my first post ever on the site and I really want to start writing an article after lurking for a couple of years.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn
